answers.core: This is about making it easier to deliver crisp visuals at any resolution, while still only having to ship one SVG file per icon with no mipmap generation needed (= less memory usage).
answers.workaround: You can use an [icon font](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/tutorials/ui/gui_using_fonts.html#using-icon-fonts) in a Label3D node, and enable MSDF font rendering in the Import dock. However, this is limited to monochrome icons, and creating this icon font can be cumbersome.
